classification_rule: Every candidate has exactly one final Phase6 class. Earlier multi-label Phase2-5 classifications are discovery provenance only.
novelty_firewall: POSSIBLY_NOVEL means only NO_DIRECT_MATCH_FOUND_IN_THIS_BOUNDED_LITERATURE_SEARCH. No candidate receives that flag in Phase6.
credit_firewalls: literature theorem != repo proof or repo source adapter
finite squareclass family != solved Diophantine equation
finite quotient bound != actual quotient enumeration or exact CVP
transvection classification != identification of a geometric action without source lock
conditional Sha theorem != unconditional Arsenal weapon
